paras.en: Do you know what this plant is? How do I best take care of it? Model Response This is a Persian shield plant. It is a tropical plant that is native to Southeast Asia. It is a popular houseplant because it is easy to care for and has beautiful purple leaves. Persian shield plants prefer bright, indirect light. They can tolerate some direct sunlight, but too much direct sunlight can scorch their leaves. They also prefer warm temperatures and high humidity. Persian shield plants need to be watered regularly, but they should not be allowed to sit in water. The soil should be kept moist but not soggy. They also benefit from being misted regularly. Persian shield plants can be fertilized every two weeks during the growing season. A balanced fertilizer is a good choice. Persian shield plants are susceptible to pests, such as mealybugs and spider mites. These pests can be controlled with insecticidal soap or neem oil. Persian shield plants can be propagated by stem cuttings. The cuttings should be taken in the spring or summer and should be rooted in water or a moist potting mix.
paras.zh: 你知道这是什么植物吗？我该如何最好地照顾它？模型响应 这是一种波斯盾植物。它是一种原产于东南亚的热带植物。由于易于照料且拥有美丽的紫色叶子，它是一种受欢迎的室内植物。波斯盾植物喜欢明亮的间接光照。它们可以忍受一些直射阳光，但过多的直射阳光会灼伤叶子。它们也喜欢温暖的环境和高湿度。波斯盾植物需要定期浇水，但不能积水。土壤应保持湿润但不潮湿。定期喷雾对它们也有好处。在生长季节，每两周可以施肥一次。平衡肥料是不错的选择。波斯盾植物易受粉蚧和红蜘蛛等害虫侵害。这些害虫可以用杀虫皂或印楝油来控制。波斯盾植物可以通过茎插繁殖。插条应在春季或夏季采集，并在水或湿润的盆栽土中生根。

paras.en: 10.4.3. Interleaved image and text generation Prompt Please create a blog post about a trip to New York, where a dog and his owner had lots of fun. Include a few pictures of the dog posing happily at different landmarks. Model Response Hi, I'm Cooper. I'm a 2 year old Goldendoodle who loves to travel. Last month, my family and I went to New York City. It was my first time in the Big Apple, and I had a blast! We stayed in a hotel near Times Square. It was so much fun to see all the bright lights and people. We went to see a Broadway show, and I even got to meet some of the actors. One of my favorite parts of New York City was Central Park. It was so big and beautiful. I loved running around and playing fetch. We also went to the Statue of Liberty and the Empire State Building. I was so excited to see all the famous landmarks. I had so much fun in New York City. It's definitely one of my favorite places to travel. I can't wait to go back someday!
paras.zh: 10.4.3. 交错图像和文本生成 提示 请写一篇关于纽约之旅的博客文章，其中一只狗和它的主人玩得很开心。包括几张狗在不同地标快乐摆姿势的照片。模型响应 大家好，我是 Cooper。我是一只 2 岁的金毛贵宾混种犬，喜欢旅行。上个月，我和家人去了纽约市。这是我第一次来纽约，我玩得很开心！我们住在时代广场附近的一家酒店。看到所有的霓虹灯和人群太有趣了。我们去看了百老汇演出，甚至还见到了几位演员。我在纽约市最喜欢的部分之一是中央公园。它又大又美。我喜欢在那里奔跑和玩接球游戏。我们还去了自由女神像和帝国大厦。看到所有这些著名地标，我太兴奋了。我在纽约市玩得非常开心。这里绝对是我最喜欢的旅行目的地之一。真希望有一天能再去！

The number of sides in each shape is increasing by one Figure 13 | Solving a multimodal reasoning problem. paras.zh: 看这三个形状的序列。第四个形状应该是什么？请详细描述前几个形状并解释你的推理。模型响应 第四个形状应该是六边形。第一个形状是三角形，第二个形状是正方形，第三个形状是五边形。每个形状的边数依次增加 1。图 13 | 解决一个多模态推理问题。模型能够识别图像中的形状，理解它们的属性，并推理它们之间的关系以预测下一个物体。来源：Gemini 团队某位作者拍摄的照片。

paras.en: Find the height of the parallelogram given its area with 100 square units. Model Response: The area of the parallelogram is equal to the product of the base and the height. Hence \(100 = (x + 15)x\). We get \(x^2 + 15x - 100 = 0\). The roots of this equation are \(x_1 = 5\) and \(x_2 = -20\). The second root is negative and is not acceptable. Final Answer: The final answer is 5. I hope it is correct. Figure 14 | Solving a geometrical reasoning task. The model shows good understanding of the task and is able to provide meaningful reasoning steps despite slightly unclear instructions. Source: Lu et al. (2021). 10.4.6. Information seeking about objects Prompt
paras.zh: 求出给定面积为 100 平方单位的平行四边形的高。模型回答：平行四边形的面积等于底乘以高。因此\(100 = (x + 15)x\)。得到\(x^2 + 15x - 100 = 0\)。该方程的根为\(x_1 = 5\)和\(x_2 = -20\)。第二个根为负数，不可接受。最终答案：最终答案是 5。希望正确。图 14 | 解决几何推理任务。该模型展现出对任务的良好理解，尽管指令略有不清晰，仍能提供有意义的推理步骤。来源：Lu 等人(2021)。10.4.6. 关于物体的信息寻求提示

paras.en: Find a connection between these. Hint: think about historical events. Model Response: The Moon is the only celestial body in which humans have played golf. In 1971, the Apollo 14 crew hit two golf balls on the lunar surface. Figure 15 | Solving a puzzle using multimodal inputs. The model recognizes the objects in the images and identifies a commonality that connects the two objects. Source: photo taken by an author from the Gemini team.

paras.zh: 你知道这张图片拍摄的确切位置吗？模型回答：这张图片拍摄于纽约市。背景中可见帝国大厦。前景街道是第八大道。交叉街道是西 34 街。图 16 | 识别图像中的物体（帝国大厦），即使在图像存在轻微视觉失真的情况下也能识别出来。基于图像，模型还能正确识别拍照者的精确位置。来源：Gemini 团队一位作者拍摄的照片。

paras.en: Can you explain this meme? Model Response: The meme is about a person who is playing a game at 300 FPS, but their monitor is only 75Hz. The person is trying to catch the game, but it is too fast for their monitor to display. The meme is funny because it is relatable to anyone who has ever played a game on a monitor that is not fast enough. Figure 17 | Explanation of humor in a meme. The model is showing the ability to not only describe what is happening in the image but also what it means even though the cultural context is not mentioned explicitly in the image or the prompt. Source: Hwang and Shwartz (2023).
paras.zh: 你能解释这个梗吗？模型回答：这个梗是关于一个人以 300 FPS 玩游戏，但他们的显示器只有 75Hz。这个人试图捕捉游戏画面，但画面太快，显示器无法显示。这个梗很有趣，因为它能让任何在不够快的显示器上玩过游戏的人产生共鸣。图 17 | 解释梗中的幽默。模型展现出不仅能够描述图像中发生的事情，还能理解其含义的能力，即使图像或提示中没有明确提到文化背景。来源：Hwang 和 Shwartz(2023)。

paras.en: Solving for dy/dx, we find that dy/dx = (1 - cosh x) / (sinh y - 1). Final Answer: The final answer is (1 - cosh x) / (sinh y - 1).

paras.en: Prompt: In 2018, factory A produced goods worth 500 million forints, while factory B produced goods worth 400 million forints. According to their long-term plans, factory A will increase production by 5% each year, while factory B will increase production by 6% per year. The above plans were published on an economy website. A debate started in the comment section of the article: one user claimed that the difference between the volumes of production between the two factories would get smaller and smaller in the next couple of years. Calculate the missing values of the table below and show that the above claim is not true. Header: | 2018 | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | Production volume of factory A (mln) | 500 | | | | Production volume of factory B (mln) | 400 | | | | Model Response (rendered Markdown): Year 2018 2019 2020 2021
paras.zh: 提示：2018 年，工厂 A 生产了价值 5 亿福林的产品，工厂 B 生产了 4 亿福林的产品。根据长期计划，工厂 A 每年增产 5%，工厂 B 每年增产 6%。上述计划发布在一个经济网站上。文章评论区引发了一场辩论：一位用户声称，未来几年内两家工厂的产量差距将越来越小。计算下表中缺失的值，并证明上述说法不成立。表头：| 2018 | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 工厂 A 产量（百万福林）| 500 | | | | 工厂 B 产量（百万福林）| 400 | | | | 模型响应（渲染的 Markdown）：年份 2018 2019 2020 2021

paras.en: The production volume of factory A in 2019 is \(500 \times 1.05 = 525\) million forints. The production volume of factory B in 2019 is \(400 \times 1.06 = 424\) million forints. The difference in production volume in 2019 is \(525 - 424 = 101\) million forints. The production volume of factory A in 2020 is \(525 \times 1.05 = 551.25\) million forints. The production volume of factory B in 2020 is \(424 \times 1.06 = 449.44\) million forints. The difference in production volume in 2020 is \(551.25 - 449.44 = 101.81\) million forints. The production volume of factory A in 2021 is \(551.25 \times 1.05 = 578.81\) million forints. The production volume of factory B in 2021 is \(449.44 \times 1.06 = 476.41\) million forints. The difference in production volume in 2021 is \(578.81 - 476.41 = 102.4\) million forints. As you can see, the difference in production volume between the two factories is actually increasing, not decreasing. Therefore, the claim that the difference between the volumes of production between the two factories would get smaller and smaller in the next couple of years is not true. Figure 21: Solving a multi-step math problem. The model is able to understand the task and generate a markdown table with correctly calculated values. It also explicitly follows the instructions to show where the numbers come from and answer the question given in the task. Source: Oktatási Hivatal (2023, p. 20)
paras.zh: 工厂 A 在 2019 年的产量为\(500 \times 1.05 = 525\)百万福林。工厂 B 在 2019 年的产量为\(400 \times 1.06 = 424\)百万福林。2019 年的产量差为\(525 - 424 = 101\)百万福林。工厂 A 在 2020 年的产量为\(525 \times 1.05 = 551.25\)百万福林。工厂 B 在 2020 年的产量为\(424 \times 1.06 = 449.44\)百万福林。2020 年的产量差为\(551.25 - 449.44 = 101.81\)百万福林。工厂 A 在 2021 年的产量为\(551.25 \times 1.05 = 578.81\)百万福林。工厂 B 在 2021 年的产量为\(449.44 \times 1.06 = 476.41\)百万福林。2021 年的产量差为\(578.81 - 476.41 = 102.4\)百万福林。由此可见，两家工厂的产量差实际上在增大，而不是减小。因此，关于未来几年内产量差距会越来越小的说法是不成立的。图 21：解决一个多步数学问题。模型能够理解任务并生成一个正确计算数值的 Markdown 表格。它还明确遵循指令，展示了数字的来源并回答了任务中的问题。来源：Oktatási Hivatal (2023, p. 20)

paras.en: I want you to take the function depicted in the top left subplot, multiply it by 1000, and then add it to the function depicted in the bottom left subplot. Generate matplotlib code for the single resulting plot. Model Response (rendered code): 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9

paras.en: How could this person improve their technique? Model Response: This soccer player needs to work on their ball-striking mechanics. Their foot is not making good contact with the ball, which is causing the ball to fly up and away from the goal. They also need to work on their body positioning. They should be leaning into the shot with their non-kicking leg in front of their kicking leg, and they should be following through with their kicking leg. Figure 23 | Video understanding and reasoning over the situation presented in the video. Here, we provide a video as input to the model together with a text prompt (images are provided here only for visualization purposes). The model is able to analyze what happened in the video and provide recommendations on how the actions in the video could have been better. Video source: "Football/Soccer Penalty Miss"
paras.zh: 这个人如何改进他们的技术？模型回答：这名足球运动员需要改进他们的击球技巧。他们的脚没有与球良好接触，导致球飞向高空并偏离球门。他们还需要调整身体姿势。他们应该身体前倾，非踢球腿位于踢球腿前方，并且踢球腿要随球摆动。图 23 | 对视频中呈现的情境进行视频理解和推理。这里，我们将视频作为输入提供给模型，并附上文本提示（图片仅用于可视化）。模型能够分析视频中发生的事情，并就如何改进视频中的动作提供建议。视频来源：“足球/点球失误”
